name: ScrapingBee MCP Server
author: ScrapingBee
description: Official hosted MCP server for ScrapingBee: read web pages as markdown, text or HTML with JavaScript rendering, extract structured data in plain English, take screenshots, and get JSON results from Google, Amazon, Walmart, YouTube, ChatGPT and Gemini. Connect to https://mcp.scrapingbee.com/mcp with OAuth or an Authorization: Bearer API key.

tools.name: get_amazon_search_results
tools.title: Amazon search results
tools.description:
Scrape Amazon search results using ScrapingBee.

Scope: one query per call, with the result returned into the conversation.

add_html.description: Whether to return the HTML along with the search results.

category_id.description: The category ID to use for the search.

country.description:
The country code for localization (e.g., us, uk, de).
Do not combine with a matching domain (e.g., country=fr&domain=fr).

currency.description: The currency code (ISO 4217) to display results (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

domain.description: The Amazon domain to use for the search (e.g., com, co.uk, de).

language.description: The language code to display results (e.g., en, fr, de).

light_request.description: Whether to use a light request or not.

merchant_id.description: The merchant ID to use for the search.

pages.description: The number of pages to scrape.

sort_by.description:
The sort order to use for the search
(most_recent, price_low_to_high, price_high_to_low, featured,
average_review, bestsellers).

start_page.description: The page number to start scraping from.

zip_code.description: The ZIP code to use for delivery localization.

screenshot.description: Force a browser screenshot (returns base64 image).

tools.name: ask_chatgpt
tools.title: Ask ChatGPT
tools.description:
This tool allows you to send a prompt to OpenAI's ChatGPT via ScrapingBee
and get back the generated response.

Scope: one query per call, with the result returned into the conversation.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to ChatGPT.

search.description: Whether to enable web search capability for the prompt.

add_html.description: Whether to include the full HTML of the page in the results.

country_code.description:
ISO country code the request should originate from

tools.name: fast_search
tools.title: Fast web search
tools.description:
Search the web using ScrapingBee's Fast Search API and return organic
results and top stories as JSON, typically in under one second and at a
lower credit cost than get_google_search_results.

For news, maps, Google Lens, shopping, image search or Google AI mode
results, use get_google_search_results.

Scope: one query per call, with the result returned into the conversation.

search.description:
The search query to use.
Make sure to URL-encode special characters such as :, & or +.

country_code.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to localize results
(Example: us, fr, de, in, gb, br, etc.).

language.description: Language of the search results (Example: en, fr, de, etc.).

page.description:
The page number to return. Default is 1,
use page=2 for the second page, etc.

tools.name: ask_gemini
tools.title: Ask Gemini
tools.description:
Ask Gemini through ScrapingBee and receive citation objects when available.

Scope: one query per call, with the result returned into the conversation.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to Gemini.

add_html.description: Whether to return the full HTML of searched pages.

country_code.description: ISO country code to set request geolocation.

tools.name: get_google_search_results
tools.title: Google search results
tools.description:
Supports specialized Google search types that fast_search does not:
news, maps, Google Lens, shopping, image search and Google AI mode. For
plain organic results, fast_search is faster and uses fewer credits.

Scrape Google search results using ScrapingBee and return the results.
This tool can scrape normal results, news results, maps results, search
using google lens, shopping related results, image results, and get the result from
Google's AI mode.
It can even return the HTML along with the search results.

Scope: one query per call, with the result returned into the conversation.

add_html.description: Whether to return the HTML along with the search results.

country_code.description:
The country code to use for the search
(Example: us, fr, de, etc.).

device.description: The device to use for the search (desktop, mobile).

extra_params.description: Extra parameters to pass to the search (Example: tbs=qdr:d&udm=7).

language.description: The language to use for the search (Example: en, fr, de, etc.).

light_request.description: Whether to use a light request or not.

nfpr.description: Whether to disable Google's autocorrection feature or not.

pages.description: Number of pages to aggregate (max 10, default 1).

search_type.description:
The search type to use (classic: normal results,
news: news results [not available if device is mobile], maps: maps results,
lens: search using google lens [requires image url as search parameter],
shopping: shopping related results, images: image results,
ai_mode: get the result from Google's AI mode, ads: paid-ad results).

date_range.description:
Filter by date range: past_hour, past_day, past_week,
past_month, past_year. Only for classic, news, and images.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees for geographic searches.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees for geographic searches.

radius.description: Radius in meters (requires latitude and longitude).

sort_by.description: Shopping sort order: relevance, reviews, price_asc, price_desc.

tools.name: get_page_text
tools.title: Get page text
tools.description:
Scrape a URL using ScrapingBee and return the page content in
Markdown or Text format.

Scope: one URL per call, with the result returned into the conversation.
This server has no batch, crawl, file-output or scheduling mode.

Docs: https://www.scrapingbee.com/documentation/remote-mcp/

url.description: The URL of the page to scrape.

return_page_markdown.description: Whether to return the page content in Markdown format.

return_page_text.description: Whether to return the page content in Text format.

auto_mode.description:
On by default — ScrapingBee automatically picks the cheapest
configuration that successfully fetches the page, escalating proxy
strength only as needed (you are charged only for the winning
config). To choose a configuration yourself instead, use one of:
auto_mode=False for the classic tier (no proxy, cheapest),
premium_proxy=True, or stealth_proxy=True — the two proxy flags
override auto_mode on their own, so auto_mode=False is only needed
for the classic tier. Setting render_js also switches to manual.

max_cost.description:
Optional credit ceiling for auto_mode (integer >= 1). The request
will not escalate to a configuration costing more than this many credits.
0 means no ceiling. Ignored unless auto_mode is True.

premium_proxy.description:
Manual option: use a premium proxy (middle tier of
classic/premium/stealth). Setting this disables auto_mode.

stealth_proxy.description:
Manual option: use a stealth proxy (strongest tier of
classic/premium/stealth). Setting this disables auto_mode.

custom_google.description:
Set to True if the url is a google domain in the following
format: <subdomain>.google.<top-level-domain>
(Example: translate.google.com, mail.google.com, www.google.co.in etc)

country_code.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "fr", "us") to
route the request through an IP in that country. Only takes effect
when premium_proxy or stealth_proxy is True.

render_js.description:
Whether to use headless-browser rendering.
Omit to use the API default (true). Setting this explicitly
switches the request to manual configuration (disables auto_mode).

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load (0–35000).

wait_for.description: CSS or XPath selector to wait for before returning.

block_resources.description: Block images/CSS to speed up rendering.

session_id.description: Integer 0–10000000 to reuse an IP for up to 5 minutes.

cookies.description: Semicolon-separated cookies to send to the target.

js_scenario.description: Stringified JSON object of browser interaction instructions.

ai_selector.description: CSS selector to focus AI extraction on part of the page.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.title: Get screenshot
tools.description:
Capture a PNG screenshot of a web page through ScrapingBee: the viewport,
the full page, or one element selected with CSS.

Scope: one URL per call, with the result returned into the conversation.
This server has no batch, crawl, file-output or scheduling mode.

Docs: https://www.scrapingbee.com/documentation/remote-mcp/

url.description: The URL of the page to scrape.

screenshot_full_page.description:
Whether to take a screenshot of the full page
or just the viewport.

screenshot_selector.description: A CSS selector to take a screenshot of a specific element.

premium_proxy.description:
Whether to use a premium proxy for the request.
Use it only if you are getting blocked by the website,
that is when you get a 500 status code.

stealth_proxy.description:
Whether to use a stealth proxy for the request.
Use it only if you are getting blocked by the website
while using premium_proxy, that is when you get a 500 status code.

custom_google.description:
Set to True if the url is a google domain in the following
format: <subdomain>.google.<top-level-domain>
(Example: translate.google.com, mail.google.com, www.google.co.in etc)

country_code.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "fr", "us") to
route the request through an IP in that country. Only takes effect
when premium_proxy or stealth_proxy is True.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load (0–35000).

wait_for.description: CSS or XPath selector to wait for before returning.

block_resources.description: Block images/CSS to speed up rendering.

session_id.description: Integer 0–10000000 to reuse an IP for up to 5 minutes.

cookies.description: Semicolon-separated cookies to send to the target.

js_scenario.description: Stringified JSON object of browser interaction instructions.

json_response.description:
Deprecated, removed in Version 3. Return the full JSON
envelope (page content plus the base64 image under its
"screenshot" key) instead of the raw image.

tools.name: get_scrapingbee_usage
tools.title: ScrapingBee usage
tools.description:
Read real-time credit and concurrency usage for the authenticated
ScrapingBee account.

Note: This endpoint is rate-limited to 6 calls per minute and does not
count against the account's concurrency limit.

Returns:
    max_api_credit, used_api_credit, max_concurrency, current_concurrency,
    renewal_subscription_date.
